analysis.reason: 직전 매수 판단 이후 3거래일 연속 관망 유지했으나, 금일 RSI 31.4에서 49.5로 과매도 구간 탈출 확인. MACD 히스토그램 또한 -51272.9768에서 2279.0884로 개선되며 상승 전환 신호 포착. 5일 저가 1,171,000원 대비 20일 저가 1,171,000원으로 Higher Low 패턴 형성 확인. 거래량도 5일 평균 대비 1.27배로 증가하며 상승 모멘텀 강화. SMA200 대비 0.17% 상승하며 지지력 확인.
analysis.reasonEn: After maintaining a wait-and-see approach for three consecutive sessions following the previous buy signal, today confirms RSI's exit from oversold territory, rising from 31.4 to 49.5. The MACD histogram also shows improvement, moving from -51272.9768 to 2279.0884, signaling a potential upward reversal. A Higher Low pattern is confirmed, with the 5-day low at 1,171,000 and the 20-day low also at 1,171,000. Trading volume increased by 1.27 times the 5-day average, reinforcing upward momentum. The price is trading 0.17% above the SMA200, indicating support.

· 52-week position (39.7%) + current price level approaching historical lows.

· MACD Histogram Trajectory (-51272.9768→2279.0884): improving, potential shift from bearish convergence to bullish expansion.

[Support & Resistance Structure]

· Swing Resistance (KRW 1,890,000): above SMA100 and R1 (KRW 1,837,667), expecting a trend reversal upon breakout.
· 5-day/20-day High/Low Pattern (Higher Low): recovery signal, suggesting potential trend reversal.
[Volume & Conclusion]
· Volume Ratio (1.27x): increased confidence in price movement, strengthening upward momentum.
· Current Phase Diagnosis (Accumulation Phase): RSI exiting oversold and MACD improving confirmed, a zone to consider for entry.
